snippet.title: Evercade - Banjo Kazooie Double Pack - Trailer
snippet.description:
Two 64-bit hits come to Evercade with brand new enhanced versions in the Banjo-Kazooie Double Pack!

Grand adventures from legendary developers Rare await you, with the most famous bear and bird of the 64-bit era, now in new enhanced format for Evercade! Conquer the secrets of Gruntilda's Lair in Banjo-Kazooie, then challenge the witch and her sisters to a rematch in Banjo-Tooie.

Find out more: https://evercade.link/banjo

Pre-orders now open!
Releases October 30th, 2026
Also included in Evercade Nexus! https://evercade.link/nexus
